reconstructed_captions.27: A new scene shows a drone flying fast and low over a grassy, sunlit ridge.
reconstructed_captions.28: The drone continues its rapid flight along the ridge, revealing a vast mountain landscape in the distance.
reconstructed_captions.29: The drone approaches a person standing on the edge of the ridge, looking out at the view.
reconstructed_captions.30: A close-up shot from behind the person shows them wearing a dark jacket, observing the mountain range.
reconstructed_captions.31: The drone begins to orbit the person, showing their profile against the backdrop of the sunlit mountains.
reconstructed_captions.32: The drone continues to circle the person on the grassy hilltop, gaining altitude.
reconstructed_captions.33: As the drone pulls back, the person is framed against the expansive valley and distant snowy peaks.
reconstructed_captions.34: The drone accelerates its backward movement, revealing more of the large grassy hill the person is standing on.
reconstructed_captions.35: The person becomes a smaller figure in the frame as the drone continues to pull back and ascend.
